newsitem.title: USA: First USA Inc ups tender offer price.
newsitem.headline: First USA Inc ups tender offer price.

text.p: Financial services company First USA Inc said on Monday that it had increased the price of its tender offer for securities issued by First USA Captial Trust I to $1,172.50 per $1,000 liquidation amount plus accumulated and unpaid distributions.

Two weeks ago, First USA said it had begun a tender offer for any and all First USA Capital Trust I 9.33 percent series A capital securities issued and 9.33 percent series B capital securities to be issued for $1,155 per $1,000 liquidation amount.
First USA Capital Trust I is a Delaware business trust guaranteed by First USA.
The offer, which is subject to completion of the previously announced merger of First USA and Banc One Corp, will expire at 9:00 EDT, on June 30, First USA said in a statement.
